visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a half-up bun, wearing a tie-dye t-shirt with cartoon characters, holds a female toddler in her arms. The toddler is wearing a red polka-dot dress with a black bodice and is chewing on a red plastic straw. They are in a modern indoor living room with light wood floors and a shelf in the background filled with toy figurines. (2) The scene shifts slightly as the woman stands next to a red shopping cart containing two large purple packs of Kirkland Signature bath tissue. She gestures with her hands while speaking animatedly to the camera, looking cheerful and energetic. (3) A close-up shot features a reward voucher held up to the camera, detailing a 2% cash back reward for an executive membership. The background is a mix of the shopping cart and the home interior. (4) A sequence of POV shots follows as a male hand reaches into the shopping cart to highlight specific items. These include large packs of tissue, boxes of 'WOW Double Roll' snacks, 'Clear Stew Beef Soup' boxes, a yellow box of 'Yuzu Tea', and a large white bag of Japanese rice. The woman occasionally appears in the frame, pointing at the items. (5) The woman stands back by the shopping cart, crossing her arms and posing confidently as she finishes her summary. The video concludes with a standard SMPTE color bar screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar BGM at a moderate tempo. A woman's voice is high-arousal and energetic, speaking rapidly in Chinese. A man's voice responds with similar enthusiasm, creating a conversational and cheerful tone. (2) As items are shown in the shopping cart, rhythmic rustling sounds of plastic packaging and cardboard boxes are heard, synced with the visual handling of goods. The woman's voice continues to detail the purchases with a high pitch variability. (3) Subtle digital 'ding' and 'whoosh' sound effects are used as transitions between scene cuts. The background music maintains a constant, happy major-mode vibe. (4) The woman concludes the video with an authoritative yet friendly tone, summarizing her findings. The BGM swells slightly before a final hard cut to silence accompanying the color bars.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle vlog meant to review and share the creator's shopping experience at Costco. Specifically, she evaluates the value of the Costco Executive (Black Card) membership by calculating her annual spending versus her cash back rewards. It combines personal storytelling with consumer tips.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While Costco products and brands are featured, the video is framed as a personal consumer review rather than a paid advertisement.
